title: Accessibility of positive-exponent boundary points
verified_literature_subcase: Positive lower exponent with local backward invariance and uniform coding-tree shrinking; includes completely invariant rational attracting basins.
remaining_gap: No proof removing the local backward-invariance hypothesis in the original general basin setting, and no holomorphic counterexample satisfying that setting.
computation_scope: Modest finite exact checks of auxiliary inequalities and abstract examples only. No formal proof assistant.
